description: Get one software record with its evidence and the requests it has been proposed for. USE WHEN you need details, sources or verification status for a software_id (or slug) from search results. NO side effects; public. Text fields come in the record's own `language`; `translations` holds the other language (English/Chinese) when the submitter provided it, so answer from the version in the user's language. Report unknown fields as unknown; 'unreviewed' records and 'claimed' evidence are not independently verified. Recovery: NOT_FOUND means the ID is wrong; search again.
